blocks.etymology: The phrase possibly comes from adjusting a sighting mechanism of a firearm to minimise the discrepancy between where the sight points and where a bullet lands on a target. Another possible source is the Cartesian coordinate system in mathematics. In the coordinate system, points are defined relative to an origin (point of reference) labeled O, which has an (x,y) coordinate pair of (0,0).

thesaurus.definition: direct onto a point or target, especially by automatic navigational aids
adjust (as by firing under test conditions) the zero of (a gun)

examples: The pilot zeroed in on the bunker and launched a guided missile.
Zero in and find a watermark in the image.
wiktionary.gloss: To focus one's aim; to zoom in and center (on something).

examples: We have zeroed in on the source of the problem.
See if you can zero in on the caller.
wiktionary.gloss: To successfully narrow down a search (for).

examples: One member of the check fraud team will zero in on the fingerprints.
wiktionary.gloss: To concentrate or focus one's attention (on a task).

examples: At the spring sale, everyone zeroed in on the bargain clothes.
wiktionary.gloss: To converge (on).
